title: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering
question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, s.amount_sold
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND co.country_name = 'United States'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),
city_pivot AS (
  SELECT cust_city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q20
  FROM base
  GROUP BY cust_city
),
good_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city
  FROM city_pivot
  WHERE q19 > 0
    AND (q20 - q19) * 1.0 / q19 >= 0.20
),
prod_pivot AS (
  SELECT b.prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q20
  FROM base b
  WHERE b.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM good_cities)
  GROUP BY b.prod_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(q19) AS tot19, SUM(q20) AS tot20 FROM prod_pivot
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.prod_id,
    (p.q19 + p.q20) AS total_sales,
    ABS((p.q19 * 1.0 / t.tot19) - (p.q20 * 1.0 / t.tot20)) * 100.0 AS share_change
  FROM prod_pivot p
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS pr
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT prod_id, share_change
FROM top20
WHERE pr <= 0.20
ORDER BY share_change ASC

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id=1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id=1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q20
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city
  HAVING q20 >= q19 * 1.2
),
prod_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id=1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id=1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q20
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790 AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM city_sales)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(q19) AS tot19, SUM(q20) AS tot20 FROM prod_sales
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.prod_id,
    p.q19, p.q20,
    (p.q19 + p.q20) AS total_sales,
    (p.q19 / (SELECT tot19 FROM totals)) * 100.0 AS share19,
    (p.q20 / (SELECT tot20 FROM totals)) * 100.0 AS share20,
    ABS((p.q20 / (SELECT tot20 FROM totals)) * 100.0 - (p.q19 / (SELECT tot19 FROM totals)) * 100.0) AS share_change
  FROM prod_sales p
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked
  WHERE total_sales >= (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.8) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_sales)
    FROM ranked
  )
)
SELECT prod_id, share_change
FROM top20
ORDER BY share_change ASC
LIMIT 20

  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND co.country_name = 'United States'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),
city_pivot AS (
  SELECT cust_city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q20
  FROM base
  GROUP BY cust_city
),
good_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city
  FROM city_pivot
  WHERE q19 > 0
    AND (q20 - q19) * 1.0 / q19 >= 0.20
),
prod_pivot AS (
  SELECT b.prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q20
  FROM base b
  WHERE b.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM good_cities)
  GROUP BY b.prod_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(q19) AS tot19, SUM(q20) AS tot20 FROM prod_pivot
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.prod_id,
    (p.q19 + p.q20) AS total_sales,
    ABS((p.q19 * 1.0 / t.tot19) - (p.q20 * 1.0 / t.tot20)) * 100.0 AS share_change
  FROM prod_pivot p
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS pr
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT prod_id, share_change
FROM top20
WHERE pr <= 0.20
ORDER BY share_change ASC
